description: Credential-free desired tool inventory for SketchScape planning and development automation.
format_status: Documentation only. This is not claimed to be a native NemoClaw, OpenShell, MCP, or agent import format.
credentials: Resolve authentication through the approved runtime credential provider; never store credentials in this file.

http_operations.purpose: Start approved GPU inference capacity before bounded reconstruction work.

Submit one or more views and prompts to SAM 3.1 followed by Fast-SAM3D to create a catalog asset. subject_hint is optional: when empty and no mask is uploaded, NemoClaw identify_subject labels the object (Build Plan step 4a; SKETCHSCAPE_SUBJECT_LABELER=mock until the runtime exists).
http_operations.approval_reason: May start or consume metered GPU capacity outside mock mode.

http_operations.purpose: List reconstructed and curated assets available to blueprints.
Create a revisioned draft conforming to shared/experience-blueprint.schema.json.
Validate schema, project asset references, readiness, and allowlisted interactions.
Promote a validated blueprint revision as the project's published source of truth.
Export a published compiled scene and same-origin PLY artifacts into the Unity authoring folder.
Fetch the runtime scene compiled from the project's published blueprint.

Collaborative VR: read the live revision, objects, and ownership of a room (callable name get_room_state). Authenticated with NemoClaw's Clerk M2M token. Build Plan steps 21 and 24; gated by scripts/check_collab_gates.py.

Collaborative VR: draft a room edit as a new revision based on the live revision (callable name propose_room_edit). Never publishes; publishing uses blueprint.publish with approval. Returns 409 if the room changed. A person approves the publish on the website. Build Plan step 24.

nemoclaw_agent_tools.path: backend/scene_tools_cli.py place_objects_in_scene (installed in the NemoClaw sandbox as the sketchscape-scene-tools OpenClaw skill, config/nemoclaw/skills/sketchscape-scene-tools/SKILL.md)
nemoclaw_agent_tools.purpose: Build Plan step 4: callable name place_objects_in_scene(objects: list[{asset_id, label}], sketch_layout_hint). Deterministic interior-design layout reasoning (arc placement, depth variation, label-driven relative scale); returns a schema-valid ExperienceBlueprintInput. Never publishes.

Build Plan step 4: callable name read_sketch_layout(sketch_image). Optional. Mock backend returns no relations (honest, no real vision signal yet); nemoclaw backend raises until NemoClaw's vision model path (Build Plan step 3) is wired up.

Build Plan step 6: callable name stage_immersive_reveal(connection_insight, objects). Reveal order, theme-keyed lighting/mood preset, connecting light-path motif, spoken-narration text, per-object haptic signature. Backend-side tool only (Part A); Unity-side toolkit integration (Part B) waits on Unity Editor being available.
